identifier.label: an identifier of 22 characters is accepted

created.label: a new identifier is 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits, is accepted as an identifier and differs from the one made before it

store.label: get gives nothing for a key without a value, the value that set stored, and nothing after remove

memory_store.new.made.label: the memory store is made without arguments, as a store of one session in the memory of the process (SE-4.1)

memory_store.get.made.label: get of a key that holds no value gives nothing (SE-2.1)

memory_store.set.made.label: set makes the key hold the value, which get gives (SE-2.1)

memory_store.remove.made.label: remove makes the key hold no value, so get gives nothing (SE-2.1)

memory_store.renew.made.label: renew of the memory store counts the renewal and changes no value (SE-4.3)

memory_store.renewals.made.label: a new memory store has counted no renewal (SE-4.3)

record.label: a found session that no call uses is unused

internal.label: the fault injection point session_store.internal makes the renewal of a memory store treat its count as passing u64, the kind internal, which no input reaches

recordFaults.label: the fault injection point session_store.internal imitates that the start of the session finds it still waiting, the kind internal, which no input reaches

raises.message: internal error: a started session waits
